_comment: Single source of the what-if / routing model catalog. Entries name MODELS only, never rates — compute_cost is the single source of every dollar figure. 'pricer' is the compute_cost routing key; order is roughly cheap → premium within a pricer. 'routing_candidate': false marks entries excluded from routing recommendations (proxy-priced or not directly pickable in the user's tool) while still available to what-if repricing. Consumed by services/whatif.py (all entries) and reports/prescribe.py (routing_candidate only).
